evidence.why: Shows the job failed due to running out of disk space.

evidence.quote: 2026-10-22T02:02:14Z ERROR loader [os-20261021] batch 4/7 failed: OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device (ENOSPC) writing /data/sqlite/orders.db-wal
evidence.why: Gives the exact error message indicating resource exhaustion on the device.
Manifest shows only 1500 rows loaded out of 3100 read before the job failed halfway through.

args.root_cause: The order_sync job for run_date 2026-10-21 failed halfway through loading because the host ran out of disk space ([Errno 28] No space left on device), resulting in only a partial load of 1,500 out of 3,100 rows and triggering the volume drop alert.
args.suggested_fix: Free up disk space on /data, resize the volume, and retry or rerun the failed job os-20261021.
